author: hero_ui
name: heroui-select
description: Accessible select built on React Aria, from HeroUI v3. A collapsible listbox with single and multiple selection, descriptions, grouped sections with headers and separators, disabled options, controlled value, primary/secondary variants, and full keyboard + typeahead support. Compound API: Select / Select.Trigger / Select.Value / Select.Indicator / Select.Popover + ListBox / ListBox.Item / ListBox.ItemIndicator / ListBox.Section / Header / Separator / Label / Description / FieldError.
